title: 2027 Lexus ES EV Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Lexus ES carries into the new model year with no significant changes, following a complete redesign for 2026.
body_markdown:
The Lexus ES sedan was introduced in 1989 as one of the brand's first two models, and is now in its eighth generation. Initially known for its stately design and demeanor, the most recent ES represents a significant departure for Lexus, with avant-garde styling and a choice of hybrid or fully electric powertrains.

## What’s New for the 2027 Lexus ES EV


The ES sedan was completely redesigned for 2026 and carries into the 2027 model year with no significant changes. As before, Lexus offers the electric ES in two forms: the ES 350e features a single motor and front-wheel drive (FWD) while the ES 500e is fitted with dual electric motors that provide all-wheel drive (AWD). Lexus also offers a hybrid-powered ES 350h, which we cover separately.


## Design


The 2026 ES debuted with a sharp new design featuring lots of angles and facets, and that hasn’t changed for 2027. Lexus’s highly recognizable spindle grille is mostly defined by flat surfaces up front, but there is a thin opening at the bottom. The sides are decorated by a hockey-stick-shaped accent, and the steeply raked roofline lends the ES a sporty look. The latest ES is 6.5 inches longer, 2.2 inches wider, and 4.5 inches taller than the previous model, blurring the line between the midsize and full-size sedan segments.


## Powertrain


The 2027 Lexus ES 350e is fitted with a single 221-horsepower motor that powers the front wheels, sufficient for a 0–60 mph time of 7.4 seconds. A 74.7-kWh lithium-ion battery pack provides the juice, and Lexus estimates the ES 350e can travel up to 307 miles with a fully charged battery. The ES 500e gets an additional electric motor that powers the rear wheels, which drops the estimated 0–60 mph time to 5.1 seconds and reduces range to 276 miles. The 2027 ES EV can charge at up to 150 kW, which isn’t particularly fast. Still, with the right kind of charger, Lexus says the ES can be recharged from 10% to 80% capacity in 28 minutes. The 2027 ES uses a North American Charging Standard (NACS) port, which makes it compatible with Tesla Supercharger stations.


## Interior


The ES's interior is roomy, clean, and modern. ES Premium models come standard with NuLuxe artificial leather upholstery, embossed door panel accents, a micro-geometric pattern dashboard trim, and ambient lighting. ES Luxury models feature semi-aniline leather-trimmed seats and an LED-backlit layered, bamboo wood-trimmed door panel design. Luxury models also get bamboo trim on the center console. An available Executive package adds a four-way power-adjustable rear passenger-side seat that includes a recline function and ottoman along with a two-way power-adjustable rear driver’s-side seat. Both outboard rear seats are heated, ventilated, and equipped with a massage function. Plush headrests, a multi-zone automatic climate control system with rear-seat controls in the center armrest, and an extra pair of USB-C ports round out the package.


## Technology


All 2027 Lexus ES EV models are equipped with a 12.3-inch display that serves as a digital gauge cluster, along with a 14-inch center touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are standard, as is a wireless device charger. Lexus’s Intelligent Assistant, which allows occupants to use voice commands to control various vehicle functions, is also included (a trial or subscription is required). ES Premium models get a 10-speaker Lexus Premium Sound audio system, while Luxury models come with a 17-speaker 1,800-watt Mark Levinson PurePlay surround-sound system.

## Safety


The Lexus Safety System+ 4.0 is standard on all 2027 ES models and includes adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, lane-departure warning, traffic-sign recognition, high-beam assist, and more. Available driver-assistance features include traffic-jam assist, lane-change assist, front cross-traffic alert, and rear pedestrian detection. Neither the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety nor the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration had crash-tested the latest Lexus ES sedan at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Lexus ES EV is on sale now and, at the time of writing, prices for the ES 350e Premium started at $49,005 (including destination) and the ES 350e Luxury trim started at $57,405. Extra-cost options include 21-inch wheels and a Convenience Package that adds additional safety equipment. The ES 500e Premium AWD starts at $52,005 and the ES 500e Luxury AWD starts at $60,405.
